title: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, how many rows are produce
question: For tenant ID `17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7`, how many rows are produced by (1) the port listing on host `drive-59` that shows port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and a running sum of standard attribute IDs within each VIF type (including VIF-type subtotals), and (2) the per–security group geometric-mean summary of port standard attribute IDs (including a final TOTAL row)? Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH port_listing AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.tenant_id,
    p.mac_address,
    SUM(p.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY b.vif_type ORDER BY p.standard_attr_id) AS running_sum
  FROM ml2_port_bindings b
  JOIN ports p ON b.port_id = p.id
  WHERE b.host = 'drive-59'
    AND p.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'
),
port_listing_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM port_listing
),
security_group_summary AS (
  SELECT
    sgpb.security_group_id,
    EXP(AVG(LN(p.standard_attr_id))) AS geometric_mean
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON p.id = sgpb.port_id
  WHERE p.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'
  GROUP BY sgpb.security_group_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'TOTAL' AS security_group_id,
    EXP(AVG(LN(p.standard_attr_id))) AS geometric_mean
  FROM ports p
  WHERE p.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'
),
security_group_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM security_group_summary
)
SELECT
  plc.cnt AS port_listing_rows,
  sgc.cnt AS security_group_summary_rows
FROM port_listing_count plc
CROSS JOIN security_group_count sgc
